specification_compliance: The diff reaches these places outside the declared touch points: frontend/e2e-components/fixtures/appHeader.tsx (TP-1); seven existing unit-test suites whose fixtures were rewritten (TP-2); and, read but unchanged, appshell/folders.ts baseShelfKey and appshell/useFolderChips.ts (TP-3). I did not count the spec, INDEX.md or review records, as instructed.

Two listed touch points are not changed by the diff: frontend/src/components/videoapp/labels.ts and frontend/src/components/readingapp/labels.ts. The This folder title is chosen in LibraryFace instead, so shelfTitle and the See all pages are untouched, which is consistent with I9.

I7: usePaged derives `phase` from whether the held answer belongs to the current fetchPage (usePaged.ts:88,125). On any condition change the grouped phase turns to `loading` in the same render, so showGrid is false and fetchFlat is null. No grid request is sent before the new shelves answer.
I6: the same `own` check drops a late shelves answer for old conditions (`held.fetchPage === fetchPage`), so it cannot switch the view.
I8: the grouped retry (grouped.retry / shelves.retry) bumps only the grouped attempt. The grid retry (flat.retry) bumps only the flat attempt, and fetchGrouped does not depend on it.
I4: no new writes to the URL, target view or group. GroupMenu still receives `group`.

I5: thisFolderKey is non-null only when chips.state.status is `ready`, which needs a first page. It is compared to shelf.key only under the folder grouping (video LibraryFace.tsx:307-311, reading LibraryFace.tsx:355-361).
I3 and I2: the 0-shelf and 2+-shelf branches are reached only when showGrid is false, and are otherwise unchanged.
i18n: the new key `shelves.thisFolder` is added only in messages-core/en.json and ja.json, under both the videoApp and readingApp namespaces, per frontend-conventions.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: When the shelves answer reports one shelf, the viewer sees the shelf skeleton and then, after a second request, the grid's own loading view (video VideoPagedGrid loading; reading a book ShelfBlock skeleton) before the cards.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Opening a leaf folder under any non-None grouping shows two loading views in a row before the grid appears; the spec names the two requests but not the two skeletons.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: The decision to show the grid uses only `total_shelves` from the first shelves page; if the grid request for the same conditions then returns zero items, the None grid's empty state is shown under a grouping.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: It needs the files to change between the shelves request and the grid request; the user would see the empty state instead of a shelf.

regression_risks: VideoPagedGrid and ReadingGrid now render under non-None groupings. Any behaviour they key on `none` or the None grouping elsewhere would now apply under single-shelf groupings too. I did not read VideoPagedGrid.

The e2e-components app-header fixture now draws two shelves and two folder chips under grouped Library faces. Playwright layout or screenshot specs that use this fixture may change, and their baselines are not part of the diff.
The video `sentinel` for shelves paging is no longer attached when showGrid is true. The reading groupedSentinel is gated by `!showGrid`. Both look correct, but they are a new coupling.
test_coverage: appSingleShelf.test.tsx covers I1/I7 for every grouping in both apps, comparing the grid request parameters with the None request and the card order. It also covers I4 (Group By, stored view, URL), paging to 60, I7/I8 shelves failure and retry, I8 grid-only retry, I6 a late two-shelf answer, the sort-change skeleton, I2 and I3 transitions from the grid, and I5 at the breadcrumb, at the root, while chips load, on chips failure and retry, and across a position change. No test covers chips that span more than one page, or a chips retry after a later-page failure, where status stays `ready` with the held base.
